# core/sha512.bastio

<!-- Generated by tests/libref.py from core/sha512.bastio: edit the source, then run tests/libref.py --write. -->

SHA-512 and SHA-384 (FIPS 180-4).

What is proved: every access is in bounds, nothing leaks, and a digest is
64 bytes (48 for SHA-384). Not proved: that the digest is SHA-512's or SHA-384's (the tests check the
FIPS 180-4 vectors, the block-boundary lengths 111, 112, 127, 128 and 129,
and a million `a`s), or that the code takes the same time for
every input (it does not branch on its data, but nothing checks that).

`import "core/sha512.bastio";` also loads [core/option.bastio](core-option.md), [core/bytes.bastio](core-bytes.md), [core/endian.bastio](core-endian.md), [core/text.bastio](core-text.md).

| Function | |
| --- | --- |
| [`sha512`](#sha512) | The SHA-512 digest of `m`. |
| [`sha384`](#sha384) | The SHA-384 digest of `m`. |

Every example below is built, verified and run by `tests/run.sh`. An `assert` in one is proved at compile time from the contracts above it.

## Functions

### `sha512`

```bastio
fn sha512(m: &Bytes) -> Bytes
  ensures blen(result) == 64
```

The SHA-512 digest of `m`: 64 bytes.

Example:

```bastio
let m = bfrom("abc");
let d = sha512(m);
let first = bget(d, 0);          // dd af 35 a1 ... a5 4c
let last = bget(d, 63);
let n = blen(d);
bfree(d);
bfree(m);
if n != 64 || first != 221 || last != 159 { return 1; }
```

### `sha384`

```bastio
fn sha384(m: &Bytes) -> Bytes
  ensures blen(result) == 48
```

The SHA-384 digest of `m`: 48 bytes (SHA-512 with other initial values,
cut to 384 bits).

Example:

```bastio
let m = bfrom("abc");
let d = sha384(m);
let first = bget(d, 0);          // cb 00 75 3f ... a7
let last = bget(d, 47);
let n = blen(d);
bfree(d);
bfree(m);
if n != 48 || first != 203 || last != 167 { return 1; }
```

## Internals

### `sha512_k`

```bastio
fn sha512_k() -> Vec[u64]
  ensures vlen(result) == 80
```

Internal: the round constants.

### `sha512_rotr`

```bastio
fn sha512_rotr(x: u64, n: u64) -> u64
  requires n >= 1 && n <= 63
```

Internal: `x` rotated right by `n` bits, 1 to 63.

### `sha512_block`

```bastio
fn sha512_block(h: &mut Vec[u64], k: &Vec[u64], w: &mut Vec[u64], m: &Bytes, at: u64)
  requires vlen(h) == 8 && vlen(k) == 80 && vlen(w) == 80 && at + 128 <= blen(m)
  ensures vlen(h) == 8 && vlen(w) == 80
```

Internal: the eight state words after the 128-byte block at `at` of `m`.

### `sha512_run`

```bastio
fn sha512_run(m: &Bytes, small: bool) -> Bytes
  ensures blen(result) == 64
```

Internal: the digest of `m` with the SHA-512 initial values, or with the
SHA-384 ones when `small` (the caller keeps 48 bytes).
